summary: Universitetsky-Tatyana-2 is a small research and educational satellite developed mainly by Taiwanese universities (National Cheng Kung University and National Central University) together with Russia's Moscow State University. It was launched on 17 September 2009 from Baikonur Cosmodrome on a Soyuz-2.1b rocket. The note is a brief one-paragraph entry with no further detail.
one_line: Universitetsky-Tatyana-2 is a small Taiwan–Russia research and educational satellite launched from Baikonur in September 2009.
key_facts: Universitetsky-Tatyana-2 is a small research and educational satellite.
It was mainly developed by Taiwan's National Cheng Kung University and National Central University.
Russia's Moscow State University also participated in developing Universitetsky-Tatyana-2.
The launch took place from Baikonur Cosmodrome.
The launch vehicle was a Soyuz-2.1b rocket.
